title: Reports from 'Report this page' are saved where nobody can read them, and HQ has no button to take a page down
what: A visitor who reports a gym web page as a scam, offensive or closed gets a thank-you, and the report is stored. But nothing in HQ, the HQ server or any other part of the product ever reads those reports, and HQ has no way to take a page down: it can only show whether a page was taken down. A scam or offensive page stays up and nobody at MettleUp ever hears of the report.
expected: Each report shows in HQ (and in Needs you), and HQ can take the page down or put it back from there.
who: visitors who report a page, the owner, gyms
fix_line: Add a reports list and a take-down button to HQ, and count new reports in Needs you

title: A member's question sent to one trainer rings only that trainer, so it can wait unseen if the trainer is away or removed
what: When a member sends a question to a named trainer, only that trainer gets the bell and browser alert; the owner gets no alert. If the trainer is on leave, never signs in, or is removed from staff, the question rings nobody. The owner can only find it by opening Member messages and looking.
expected: A question to a trainer still reaches someone: the owner is alerted when the trainer is removed, or when it has had no reply for a day or two.
how_often: whenever the chosen trainer is away or removed
fix_line: Alert the owner when a trainer question has no reply after a set time or its trainer is gone

title: A plan payment whose confirmation from the payment company is lost is checked again for only 48 hours, then forgotten
what: If the payment company's message saying a gym paid never arrives, the nightly check asks the company only about pay links opened in the last 48 hours. A pay link lasts 24 hours, so a payment gets one or two nightly checks. If those runs fail or are missed, the money is taken, the gym gets no plan, and the payment never appears in Payments to check, because it is still marked open.
expected: Pay links still open after the check window show up in Payments to check (or Needs you) so no paid link is ever silently dropped.
who: gym owners who pay online, the owner
how_often: rare: only when the payment message and the nightly checks both fail
fix_line: List pay links still open after 48 hours in Payments to check

title: One secret signs phone checks, AI credit spending, join payments and web page chats, with no way to change it without breaking all of them
what: The same single secret, kept in one database row and copied into the web server, proves phone numbers, lets AI answers spend a gym's credits, ties join payments to the right gym and signs web page chats. The database accepts only one value. Changing it (for example if the laptop or a copy leaks) breaks all four at once until both places are changed, and no change file says how to change it safely.
expected: Each job has its own secret, or the database accepts an old and a new secret during a change-over, and the written steps for changing it are kept where someone other than Claude can find them.
how_often: whenever the secret must be changed
fix_line: Let the database accept a second secret during a change and write down the change steps

title: Plan receipts can go out with no business name, and nothing warns that the setting is empty
what: The legal business name on every MettleUp plan receipt comes only from a setting that starts empty and must be filled by hand on the live server. If it was never filled, receipts are still numbered and issued with no legal name, and neither HQ nor the receipt says anything is missing.
expected: HQ warns while the receipt business name is empty, before any online payment is taken.
who: gym owners who pay MettleUp, the owner
how_often: every receipt while the setting is empty
fix_line: Show a warning in HQ while the receipt business name is not set

items.reason: the database change files hold no help articles; only short alert and refusal words
